proof_summary: Faulhaber’s formula and the finite-field power-sum congruence give the von Staudt–Clausen valuation criterion, from which a prime-by-prime analysis shows that squarefreeness of the denominator is equivalent (for odd composite \(n\)) to \(n\) being squarefree and every prime \(p\mid n\) satisfying \(p-1\mid n-1\); Korselt’s criterion then identifies these conditions with the Carmichael property. For even composite \(n\), \(B_{n-1}=0\), so the denominator has a repeated factor of \(2\), while the base \(-1\) also rules out the Carmichael congruence.
